_comment: Retarget targets for the Character Farm. UniRig rigs a mesh to its own skeleton (generic 'bone_N' for arbitrary meshes, or the trained 'vroid'/J_Bip humanoid). The retarget stage (Blender, retarget_char.py) renames/reorients/reskins that onto one of these named profiles and grafts animation clips. 'synty' is THE rig type THIS Godot project understands (drop-in for player_3d.gd) and is the default. Other profiles are for shipping the same character to other engines. Add a profile to support another rig.

synty.description: Hunkle Bunkle's own rig — the Synty POLYGON character skeleton + the game's 9 shared animation clips. A character on this profile is drop-in for scripts/3d/player_3d.gd / enemy_3d.gd (they find the AnimationPlayer and play clips by name).
synty.clip_reuse_note: Canonical mesh-free clip library (make_clip_library.py, extracted from quinn.glb). All characters carry these 9 clips on this identical skeleton, so the retarget grafts them verbatim (no re-authoring). Regenerate the library if the clips change.

bone_map._note: Keyed by SOURCE profile -> {source_bone: synty_bone}. Used to rename a source rig's bones to Synty (retarget_char.py) and to drive motion retarget (retarget_anim.py). UniRig humanoids land here as 'vrm' (trained vroid/J_Bip class) — verify in the gen pipeline.

godot_generic.description: Any-skeleton Godot Skeleton3D — ship the rig as-is (renamed lightly), let the game assign a BoneMap in-editor. For non-Synty Godot projects.

mixamo.description: Mixamo humanoid (mixamorig:*). Interchange hub; Mixamo animation library applies directly.
mixamo._note: UniRig defines a mixamo skeleton but its checkpoint marks mixamo 'untrained, do not use' — so we reach Mixamo via Blender rename from vroid/generic, not natively.

unreal.description: Unreal Engine 5 Mannequin (pelvis, spine_01.., upperarm_l, thigh_l, foot_l ...). FBX, cm, for UE skeletal-mesh import + IK Retargeter.

unity.description: Unity Humanoid (Avatar). FBX/GLB; Unity maps via the Humanoid avatar.

vrm.description: VRM / VRoid humanoid (J_Bip_*). UniRig's trained 'vroid' class can emit this natively — passthrough/minimal remap.

raw.description: UniRig output untouched (generic bone_N). For quadrupeds/creatures with no humanoid standard — ship the rig + bones as-is.
